ops.text: `ccx vcs ship` in cc-review routes to the Graphite lane (a live `.git/.graphite_repo_config` exists) but `gt submit` fails with "Graphite could not verify you have access to the repo yasyf/cc-review" — the repo's actual flow is linear pushes to main, so every ship here needs `--no-gt` (and after a lane-created stacked branch, the commit has to be hand-fast-forwarded onto main). Either fix gt auth or drop the stale Graphite config so ship's autodetection stops misrouting.
